status: DESIGN CONTRACT ONLY; CPU5 RTL NOT IMPLEMENTED / NOT RUN
counter_enable_rule: Exactly one event bit per enabled counted CPU cycle; all zero when count_enable is false.
selection_rule: First exclude causes masked by older blocking owners; select the cause preventing the oldest live progress, then use priority_order to break ties among eligible causes. Frontend causes require downstream capacity and consumption intent.
sampling_rule: CPU events are registered with each counted edge. Stats consumes the previous registered event; snapshot profile_next (count + incoming registered event) on START/STOP AR handshake to align with the cycle_count input. Verify actual implementation edge-by-edge before claiming PASS.
window_rule: Last START replaces all earlier START snapshots. STOP must occur exactly once after selected START. Require raw_start>=1, selected_start==1, selected_epoch==raw_start, stop==1, owner_crossings audited explicitly.
compatibility: Keep old schema3/profile1 six-bit RTL, firmware, offsets and formal bitstreams unchanged. New firmware/reader/SoC variant must explicitly require schema4/profile2/ten bits. Never connect a ten-bit producer to a six-bit consumer or append fields using one linear bank stride.

classes.name: work_other
classes.meaning: All remaining counted cycles, including useful parallel work and unclassified startup/drain/control overhead.

classes.name: ifetch_wait
classes.meaning: Downstream has capacity and intent, no older cause blocks progress, but frontend has no usable instruction; include actual request/response/stale-drain gaps.

classes.name: data_read_wait
classes.meaning: Oldest blocking nonlocal LOAD/read-side-effect D transaction prevents MEM progress.

classes.name: data_write_wait
classes.meaning: Oldest blocking nonlocal STORE/write-side-effect D transaction prevents MEM progress.

classes.name: local_mmio_wait
classes.meaning: Oldest blocking local MMIO D transaction prevents MEM progress.

classes.name: redirect_wait
classes.meaning: An age-valid redirect actually creates an instruction supply gap; event counts are separate.

classes.name: mul_wait
classes.meaning: A live MUL-family owner actually blocks EX/MEM progress; no double count with its start/complete events.

classes.name: div_wait
classes.meaning: A live DIV/REM-family owner actually blocks EX/MEM progress, including measured fast-path waits.

classes.name: load_use_wait
classes.meaning: A not-ready LOAD producer actually prevents ID/EX dependent progress and is not masked by an older cause.

classes.name: id_hazard_wait
classes.meaning: Other actual ID RAW stalls, including branch/JALR dependency; excludes load_use_wait.
